summary: Iteration 3 tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass covering /api/analytics/comparison (wow shape+7d window+delta keys; mom 30d; invalid 400; filters honored - Update Rekening reduces both current+previous totals), /api/import backup creation (payload.backup populated, filename data_YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.xlsx, size>0), /api/import/backups listing (sorted newest-first with filename/size/created), /api/import/restore (valid filename restores, invalid returns 404, path traversal ../ and \ and sub/ all return 400). Frontend: SavedViews dropdown opens; save button disabled with no filter/name; after applying categories=Update Rekening + typing name, save succeeds; localStorage 'kyc-analytics-saved-views' contains the view with id/name/filters/granularity/createdAt. Compare toggle: WoW shows compare-period-banner with two ranges; MoM banner text confirmed '2025-06-29 → 2025-07-28 vs 2025-05-30 → 2025-06-28'; toggling Off hides banner and removes kpi-total-delta from DOM. Import dialog: tab-import + tab-backups present; Backups tab lists 2 backup items with restore buttons; clicking backup-restore-<filename> triggered restore (toast 'Restored dari backup data_prerestore_20260725-123845.xlsx (3,000 baris)' visible).

ui_bugs.issue: For WoW, kpi-pending-delta and kpi-sla-delta are NOT rendered when the corresponding delta value is null. DeltaChip has `if (value === null) return null`. Backend returns null when previous==0 (division by zero in _pct) or when either period's avg_sla_days is None. With current dummy dataset in WoW window, previous.pending == 0 => pending_pct=null; and one of the periods has no valid SLA rows => sla_days=null. Spec says 'each KPI card gets a delta chip' - suggest rendering a neutral chip like 'n/a' or 'new' instead of hiding.

issues: Repeated 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on chart mount (carried over from iter2, non-blocking)

action_items: In KpiCards.DeltaChip, render a fallback chip (e.g., 'n/a' or 'new') when value is null instead of returning null, so all 5 KPI cards consistently show a delta indicator when compareMode is active (spec explicitly lists kpi-pending-delta and kpi-sla-delta as required).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py restore endpoint blocks '/','\','..' in filename - good; but also permits any file matching data_*.xlsx (glob), meaning if a malicious upload placed a file into BACKUP_DIR through some other path (currently only shutil.copy2 does so from server code, so acceptable).
Comparison endpoint _pct returns None when previous == 0, causing UI chips to disappear entirely. Consider returning a sentinel like 'inf' or a flag so UI can render 'new' state.
SavedViews stores an ISO createdAt but never renders it; also no name-uniqueness check (duplicate view names allowed). Minor UX.
ImportDialog useEffect calls loadBackups() every time dialog opens; fine but no debounce needed given small list.
Global mutable DF persists across restore/import; not thread-safe (flagged prior iterations).

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (1 medium UI gap on hidden delta chips)

seed_data_creation: Uploaded /app/backend/data/data_dummy_3000.xlsx via /api/import to generate backup entries; multiple data_YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.xlsx and one data_prerestore_YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.xlsx exist in /app/backend/data/backups/.
